title: Guest Network Segmentation with ACLs
summary: Implement and troubleshoot enterprise guest network segmentation using named extended IPv4 Access Control Lists on a Cisco edge router. Enforce least privilege access by permitting essential public DNS, HTTP, and HTTPS services to external servers while strictly isolating and dropping untrusted guest traffic destined for sensitive corporate intranet subnets.
learning_objectives: Enforce Layer 3 security boundaries between untrusted guest networks and internal corporate resources
Configure named extended IPv4 Access Control Lists with protocol, port, and subnet filtering
Apply inbound ACL filtering on edge router interfaces closest to the traffic source
Permit designated public services including DNS (UDP 53) and HTTP/HTTPS (TCP 80/443) while blocking private corporate subnets
Diagnose and remediate ACL directionality errors, rule ordering issues, and missing application statements

source.origin: Independently authored enterprise perimeter security and guest isolation lab guide based on Cisco IOS extended access list filtering standards
